profile.headline: 👉🏾Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer with 9+ years of experience building enterprise applications, cloud services, and AI-assisted developer tooling across ASP.NET Core, React, and AWS. Experienced in integrating LLMs into production workflows, building resilient backend services, and solving complex challenges in distributed systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
👉🏾 Develop and extend enterprise warehouse systems by building Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central extensions (AL) and ASP.NET Core applications supporting manufacturing and logistics.
👉🏾 Integrated Anthropic Claude into an internal engineering platform, creating AI workflows that analyze bugs, guide developers' questions, generate solutions, and create reviewable Git branches.
👉🏾 Designed thread-safe caching, concurrency control, and resiliency patterns for high-traffic ASP.NET Core services, including per-key cache synchronization, centralized rate limiting, and circuit-breaker protection for Business Central integrations.
👉🏾 Built the Business Central integration layer with MSAL token caching, request throttling, and observability to improve reliability.
👉🏾 Designed a fail-closed authorization framework with centralized page registration, role-based permissions, per-user overrides, and automated permission synchronization to manage access across 100+ application pages securely.

positions.title: AI Data & Software Engineering Contributor
positions.description:
👉🏾 Develop benchmark-quality software implementations that serve as reference solutions for training and evaluating large language models on complex programming tasks.
👉🏾 Assess AI-generated code for correctness, edge cases, performance, and maintainability, helping define the engineering standards used to measure coding model quality.
👉🏾 Contribute across multiple programming languages and frameworks, applying software engineering best practices to improve the reliability and consistency of AI evaluation datasets.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
👉🏾 Delivered client sites on WordPress/WooCommerce and React, owning planning through deployment in Agile sprints.
👉🏾 Improved site performance and search visibility through SEO and front-end tuning.
👉🏾 Managed hosting, domains, and ongoing support as primary technical point of contact.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
👉🏾 Built internal logistics and inventory apps using ASP.NET MVC, SQL Server, and jQuery to streamline warehouse operations.
👉🏾 Programmed Arduino-based diagnostic systems that replaced manual functionality checks on mobile devices, reducing QA effort and improving test consistency.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
👉🏾 Architected and deployed a microservices platform on PHP (Laravel) and AWS, improving scalability and enabling independent service deployment.
👉🏾 Built automated testing and CI/CD-supported cloud deployments, reducing release errors and deployment time.

positions.title: Owner / Software Architect
positions.description:
👉🏾 Founded and led a 5-developer team delivering custom software and IoT systems for client organizations.
👉🏾 Owned architecture and delivery across web and embedded projects, from client requirements through deployment.
